Download SCF Data Locally (Imputation-Ready)

Source: R/scf_download.R
scf_download.Rd

Downloads and processes microdata from the U.S. Federal Reserve's Survey of Consumer Finances (SCF). For each requested year, saves an .rds file containing a list of five implicates, each merged with scaled replicate weights. Designed for immediate use with scf_load().

scf_download(years = seq(1989, 2022, 3), overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

years

A numeric vector of SCF years to download (e.g., c(2001, 2019)). Must be from 1989 to 2022 in 3-year intervals. Defaults to all valid years.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, redownload and reprocess data even if .rds files already exist. Default is FALSE.

Value

A character vector of file paths for the saved .rds files. Each file contains a list of 5 cleaned data.frames (one per implicate).

Details

Each year of SCF data includes:

  • A main .dta file with 5 implicates (stacked vertically)

  • A replicate weight file with 999 weights and multiplicity scalars

This function performs the following:

  • Downloads the main data and replicate weights via FTP

  • Splits the main file into 5 implicates using the last digit of the SCF household ID (y1)

  • Merges each implicate with replicate weights by yy1

  • Scales replicate weights using associated multiplicity factors (mm1 to mm999)

  • Returns a list of 5 implicates per year and saves them as a single .rds file per year

Note

This function is intended as the first step in the SCF analysis pipeline. After downloading, use scf_load() to convert the .rds files into multiply-imputed survey design objects.

References

  • SCF Project: https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/scfindex.htm

See also

scf_load(), scf_subset(), scf_mean(), scf_ols()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Download all available SCF years
scf_download()

# Download only 2004 and 2016
scf_download(years = c(2004, 2016))

# Redownload and overwrite local files
scf_download(overwrite = TRUE)
} # }
